csv_project_name: Planning for Milwaukie Main Street Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Milwaukie May be Seeking a Consultant to Provide a Planning Service for Replace sidewalk sections that are broken or do not meet ADA requirements. Retrofit pedestrian ramps that do not meet ADA requirements. Reduce width of Main Street in front of City Hall by adding on-street parking spots. Grind and inlay Scott Street and Main Street. Adding striping and signage along the corridor, including marked pedestrian crossing at all intersections of Main Street. City Hall to Washington Street Wastewater Improvements: Replace approximately 500 feet of old main line north of Scott Street. Stormwater Improvements: Replace existing storm water main lines under both sidewalks between Harrison and Jackson streets with a single pipe in the center of the travel lanes. Upgrade current catch basins with CG-2 catch basins.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *- The RFQ/RFP package is expected to be available prior to 07/01/2029- Contract value: $1.5M- IMS requests NO PHONE CALLS, NO FAXES, and NO CONTACT with agency at this time.
title: Planning for Milwaukie Main Street Improvements
short_description: Street corridor improvements with ADA, utility, stormwater, and traffic upgrades in Milwaukie.
project_scope: Main Street corridor improvements in Milwaukie including replacement of broken or non-ADA-compliant sidewalk sections, retrofit of pedestrian ramps to ADA standards, reduction of Main Street width in front of City Hall by adding on-street parking, grind and inlay works on Scott Street and Main Street, corridor striping and signage, and marked pedestrian crossings at all Main Street intersections. Utility works include approximately 500 feet of wastewater main replacement north of Scott Street and stormwater replacement under both sidewalks between Harrison and Jackson Streets with a single pipe in the center of the travel lanes, plus catch basin upgrades to CG-2 catch basins.
services: Planning services with requested disciplines including landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a streetscape and roadway improvement project, not a bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Scope focuses on sidewalks, ADA ramps, parking, paving, striping, signage, and utility replacement.
- Requested services are planning and civil/traffic/stormwater disciplines rather than structural design of complex load-bearing structures.
- Falls close to excluded urban/open space planning and standard municipal infrastructure work.
- No indication of innovative structural systems, long spans, or architecturally demanding structures relevant to sbp.
